entities.name: Antal Grassalkovich I.

entities.summary: Count Antal I "Anton" Grassalkovich de Gyarak was an Imperial Real Privy Councilor, president of the Royal Hungarian Court Chamber, Chief Justice of Hungary (1731–1748), and confidant of Empress Maria Theresia.
